compiled_state.title: [merge-to-main.sh]: post-merge commit hash check -> exit 1 after successful squash-merge
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## 1. Technical Environment

* **Plugin/Tool Versions:** dso-dev 1.16.11
* **Active Configs:** merge.strategy=pr
* **code_version:** 00770c2370a762ff8d67f86472a1874b6833566c

## 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

After `merge-to-main.sh` merges a PR, it should exit 0 when the PR's GitHub state is `MERGED`.

#### Actual Behavior

The script exited 1 with:

```
INFO: PR #58 merged successfully.
ERROR: PR reported merged but merge commit 9c9c6bacc3faf2ce10c7195a440e829a93ea1c8b not found on origin/main (PR: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/58)
```

The commit hash `9c9c6ba` is the pre-squash commit on the source branch. Squash-merge creates a new commit SHA on main, so the original hash will never appear there. The post-merge check compares against the wrong SHA.

The PR (and the merge) were genuinely successful — `gh pr view 58` confirmed `state: MERGED, mergedAt: 2026-05-06T18:05:03Z`.

## 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * Ran `.claude/scripts/dso merge-to-main.sh` from worktree `worktree-20260505-220349`
  * Script created PR #58, queued auto-merge, and confirmed merge
  * Post-merge validation looked for pre-squash commit hash on `origin/main`
* **Known Workarounds:** Verify via `gh pr view <N> --json state` instead of commit hash lookup. Script exits 1 but the merge is complete — no data loss.

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 2 (BASIC). ROOT_CAUSE: gh pr view --json mergeCommit --jq .mergeCommit.oid returns the source-branch HEAD SHA for squash merges (known GitHub API limitation), not the new squash commit on main. After git fetch, git rev-parse origin/main gives the correct SHA. Fix: fall back to git rev-parse origin/main when API SHA not found on origin/main. confidence: high
